mapper.select: SELECT * from sort where id in(select parentId from product where deleteSign = 0) union all select id, parent_id, fin_sort_name as name, fin_sort_level as level, fin_sort_description as description, fin_sort_code as code, vault from fin_sort where id in (select fin_sort_id from fin_product where deleteSign = 0)

select * from sort where id in (select parentId from product where id = #{productId} and vault = #{vault}) union all select id,parent_id,fin_sort_name as name,fin_sort_level as level,fin_sort_description as description ,fin_sort_code as code,vault from fin_sort where id in (select fin_sort_id from fin_product where id = #{productId} and vault = #{vault})
